_comment: SYNTHETIC — hand-built from the documented response shapes in Yahoo's official
Fantasy Sports API guide and from published wrapper-library samples (yfpy,
yahoo_fantasy_api). NOT a live capture. Yahoo API access is gated behind an
approval application and NO live call has ever been made from this repo.
Replace with a real redacted capture once API access is approved.
AUTHORED 2026-08-11 (not captured on any date).
MODELS: GET /fantasy/v2/league/449.l.529351/draftresults?format=json
(2024 season, game key 449 — pairs with the 2025 auction fixture)
REDACTION: all identifiers invented. Player names are real NFL players; the
numeric ids attached to them are PLAUSIBLE BUT UNVERIFIED.
WHY THIS IS COMMITTED: in a snake draft the `cost` key is ABSENT FROM EVERY
PICK, and that absence means something different from the absence in
yahoo_draft_auction.json pick 6. Here it means 'this league has no prices at
all'; there it means 'this league has prices and Yahoo did not give one for
this pick'. The parser cannot tell those apart from the picks alone — which
is precisely why is_price_bearing is recorded on the parent fantasy_drafts
row from the league SETTINGS (is_auction_draft), not inferred from the picks.
Call parse_draft_results(..., is_auction=0) against this file and
draft_kind must be 'snake', is_price_bearing 0, and every auction_cost NULL.
Calling it with is_auction=None must give draft_kind 'unknown' — an honest
'we did not fetch settings first', not a guess.
SHAPE HAZARDS DELIBERATELY PRESENT:
1. draft_results is a numeric-key COLLECTION with a sibling 'count'.
2. Snake ORDER is the data: round 1 runs t.1 → t.12 and round 2 runs
t.12 → t.1. If iter_collection sorted keys lexically, "10","11","12"
would land before "2" and the reversal — the only evidence the draft was
a snake — would be destroyed.
3. `round` arrives as an int on some picks and a string on others.
4. No player_id, no editorial_player_key: player_uid is reconstructed from
the season-scoped player_key using the game CODE ('nfl.p.31056'), so the
same player in the 2024 and 2025 fixtures resolves to ONE uid.
TRUNCATED to 14 of ~180 picks: the first full round plus the start of the
reversed second round. Reason: the round-1/round-2 boundary is the only part
of a snake draft that carries information a later round would not repeat.
